p: Welcome to the official documentation for Discollab.org!
Please refer to our Discord server for any assistance you may need.
Get notified as soon as someone votes for your listing on Discollab! We'll send a POST request to your provided endpoint.

Your first step is to visit our dashboard and select the server or bot you want a vote webhook for, then select the Additional Info tab. At the bottom of this tab, you'll see 2 inputs where you can provide us with your endpoint URL and its token.
To verify that a webhook came from Discollab, be sure to check the Authorization header. It should be set to Bearer token, where token is the one you set in our dashboard.
If you're using a firewall, be sure to whitelist the IP 51.222.204.155.
Always set to boolean false, unless using Send Test Webhook on our dashboard, then it becomes true.
